name: Suna Studio
description: A production-ready single-page React + TypeScript AI music studio that generates real songs through Suna AI's public Hugging Face Space via @gradio/client. A prompt-first composer (Simple/Custom modes, six artist presets, editable lyrics, a Turbo/High-Fidelity synthesis engine switch, 24-68s length, optional sing-to-masterpiece vocal upload with a vocal/band mix) feeds the Space's live generate_suna_track endpoint; results land in a session-only library with a Spotify-style near-black player bar (play/pause, seek, volume, MediaSession metadata), interactive mobile player sheet, telemetry and sung-lyric sheets, and WAV-master downloads. Deep-current cinematic dark palette - near-black blue canvas with a hand-built living ocean backdrop (swaying god-rays, drifting bioluminescent dust, breathing caustic light), floating glass composer under a large serif display hero with an accent-word emphasis, slim icon rail, poster-strip session gallery, and a restrained ice-cyan accent - with honest live states and no fake progress bars.
features: real AI music generation through Suna AI's public Space via @gradio/client v2 (/gradio_api/info availability probe, /generate_suna_track endpoint)
prompt-first composer with Simple and Custom modes, ⌘/Ctrl+Enter submit, and 500-character prompt budget
six artist presets (Indila Chanson, Matushka Folk-Pop, Power Ballad, Arena Rock, Afro-Latin Pop, Slap House) with the Space's exact API enum values
editable lyrics editor with songbook autofill that matches the Space's preset-change behavior
Turbo (8-step) / High-Fidelity (16-step) synthesis engine switch and 24-68s length slider mirroring the Space's controls
optional sing-to-masterpiece vocal clip upload (drag & drop, 25MB budget, clip duration read) with a 0.30-1.20 vocal/band mix
honest generation states - connecting, composing with a real elapsed timer, queue notices, and Space error text surfaced verbatim; no fabricated progress percentages
session-only track library with rename, remove, clear, and copy-prompt; tracks never leave the tab and expire with the Space's temp files
Spotify-style near-black player bar with play/pause, seek slider, seek-ahead/behind, volume, mute toggle, and keyboard shortcuts
MediaSession metadata (title, artist, album artwork) for OS media controls
expansive NowPlaying card with track stats, Suna telemetry, and the Space's word-aligned sung-lyric sheet
full-screen mobile player sheet (dialog, focus trap, Escape to close) and mobile session drawer
downloads prefer the Space's 48 kHz 16-bit WAV master, falling back to the 320kbps MP3

deep-current cinematic design system: Instrument Serif display + Inter + IBM Plex Mono, #05070D canvas, #0D1322 glass cards, #76CDE0 ice-cyan accent, #030509 near-black player, centered serif display hero with an accent-word emphasis, slim icon rail, poster-strip session gallery, and a living ocean backdrop (god-rays, a swappable seamless moonlit wave-crest texture asset, rising bioluminescent dust, caustic light, depth vignette)
semantics - landmark structure, aria-pressed chips, labeled sliders, role=status generation card, focus-visible rings, prefers-reduced-motion handling
